mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in WORKPLACES mobility raises weekday footfall near offices and lunch districts, and this lifts RETAIL_REC within four weeks as commuting-linked purchases rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded from -22.7 at t-1w to -3.4 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC stayed near -10.6
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays above its last-4-week average and RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week average within 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated while TRANSIT is depressed, people substitute toward local errands and neighborhood retail, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds +8 and TRANSIT stays below -15 for at least one week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 12.9 at t-1w and TRANSIT was -20.6 at t-1w
failure_condition: If the RESIDENTIAL-high and TRANSIT-low condition holds but RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in PARKS mobility diverts discretionary time toward outdoor recreation and away from shopping trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -22.4 at t-3w to -8.3 at t-1w while RETAIL_REC remained negative
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above its recent average and RETAIL_REC rises above its recent average over the next 28 days, the displacement mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT indicates tighter movement frictions or fewer commuting trips; within one week this reduces mall and downtown access and lowers RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week from an already negative level
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -14.9 at t-0w after -20.6 at t-1w, while RETAIL_REC was -10.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT drops by more than 5 points from a negative baseline and RETAIL_REC does not fall in the following week, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM turns positive, routine out-of-home errands normalize and spill over into convenience shopping, supporting higher RETAIL_REC over the next two to four weeks.

failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM turns positive after a negative stretch but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where workplace mobility is volatile, a sharp WORKPLACES rebound after a dip creates pent-up commuting and lunch demand that lifts RETAIL_REC over the following month.
